'''Prowler's Trail''' was an area located on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] near to the [[Imperial Guard Academy]]. During the [[Revanite crisis]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established an [[Imperial Forward Camp]] in the area.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prowler's Trail appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
